title: New Year Table
statementMd:
Gerald is setting the New Year table. The table has the form of a circle; its radius equals $*R*$. Gerald invited many guests and is concerned whether the table has enough space for plates for all those guests. Consider all plates to be round and have the same radii that equal $*r*$. Each plate must be completely inside the table and must touch the edge of the table. Of course, the plates must not intersect, but they can touch each other. Help Gerald determine whether the table is large enough for $*n*$ plates.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*$, $*R*$ and $*r*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *r*, *R* ≤ 1000$) — the number of plates, the radius of the table and the plates' radius.

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without the quotes) if it is possible to place $*n*$ plates on the table by the rules given above. If it is impossible, print "`NO`".

Remember, that each plate must touch the edge of the table.

## Note

The possible arrangement of the plates for the first sample is:

statementZhMd:
杰拉尔德正在布置新年餐桌。餐桌是一个圆形，其半径为 $*R*$。杰拉尔德邀请了许多客人，他想知道餐桌是否有足够的空间放下所有客人的盘子。假设所有盘子都是圆形的，且半径均为 $*r*$。每个盘子都必须完全位于餐桌内部，并且必须与餐桌边缘相切。当然，盘子之间不能相交，但可以彼此相切。请帮助杰拉尔德判断餐桌是否足够放下 $*n*$ 个盘子。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*R*$ 和 $*r*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *r*$、$*R* ≤ 1000$）——盘子的数量、餐桌的半径以及盘子的半径。

## 输出格式

如果可以按照上述规则在餐桌上放置 $*n*$ 个盘子，输出 `YES`（不含引号）。如果无法做到，输出 `NO`。

请注意，每个盘子都必须与餐桌边缘相切。
